generalNotes: Install and commission equipment in accordance with the approved product documentation, project specifications and adopted code. Verify listings and installation conditions before procurement.
Field-verify circuit voltage, source identity, enclosure locations, access and actual one-way cable lengths before installation. Coordinate discrepancies with the designer.
Maintain required separation, barriers and wiring methods between power-limited circuits and branch circuits. Cable voltage rating alone does not authorize mixed routing.
Verify conductor material, gauge, insulation, environmental rating, ampacity and terminal capacity for every run. Account for applicable ambient and grouping adjustments.

Do not parallel power-supply outputs or field conductors unless the listed equipment instructions and applicable rules permit the arrangement. Provide approved distribution and overcurrent protection as required.

Route wired DMX as a daisy chain or through a listed opto-splitter. Terminate the final receiver of each physical segment as required by the receiving equipment instructions. Verify shield and common connections.
Observe the tape manufacturer maximum run, feed arrangement, cut interval, polarity and thermal mounting requirements. Coordinate extra feeds and accessible power supplies where required.
Apply the project PSU operating-load target of 80% unless a reviewed project setting specifies otherwise. This company target is separate from the listed supply rating and circuit sizing rules.

Treat DALI bus insulation and routing in accordance with the actual devices and adopted code; do not assume a DALI pair is SELV or may share a raceway solely because its nominal signal voltage is low.
Coordinate controller protocols, addressing, universes, data link lengths and termination during commissioning. Verify operation of all channels at the maximum permitted operating load.
Single-ended SPI data runs above the project limit require a compatible differential link or revised controller location. Size pixel power separately from the data connection.
Seal, protect and support outdoor and direct-burial cable systems using products listed for the actual location. Verify cable, splice and enclosure ratings as a complete installation.
